summary: Regression test after async->def conversion + atomic sale/return transactions, on PROD Supabase (Pharmacie Centrale only). Backend: 34/34 pytest pass (login+/auth/me, 26 main GETs all 200, product create -> stock movement supply 5 -> price update -> cash sale qty2 => stock 5->3, qty10 => 409 'Stock insuffisant' stock unchanged, cart with unknown product => 404 + rollback (stock unchanged), customer max_debt_limit=5000 persisted, debt sale 3000 => 1 debt of 3000, 2nd debt sale => 400 'Crédit insuffisant' stock unchanged, return qty1 => 200 stock+1, return qty2 => 400). Extra small concurrency test: 4 parallel sales qty1 on stock=2 => [200,200,409,409], final stock 0 (no oversell). Frontend: login, dashboard numbers, Products/Sales/Debts/Reports/Users pages load with zero 4xx/5xx API responses; POS sale (cash) => POST /api/sales 200, toast 'Vente enregistrée avec succès N° VNT-...', sale shown at top of history.

minor.issue: Pre-existing (not regression): unit_price and totals are taken from the client payload (item.unit_price) rather than product.price; a cashier can sell at any price, including 0 GNF (POS allowed a 0 GNF sale for a product without price).
Pre-existing: sale stock deduction does not insert a StockMovement row (returns/supplies do), so stock movement history is incomplete for sales.

issues: Products with price 0 can be added and sold for 0 GNF without warning

action_items: Optional: compute sale line prices server-side from product.price (or validate against it) and reject 0-price sales
Optional: record a StockMovement (type sale/out) inside the create_sale transaction for traceability
critical_code_review_comments: create_sale: settings_repo.get('debt_overdue_days') opens a separate session inside the locked transaction - fine but holds row locks slightly longer; consider reading settings before acquiring locks.
returns.create_return: uuid.UUID(return_data.sale_id) / uuid.UUID(item_product_id) not wrapped -> invalid UUID gives 500 instead of 400/404.
Files Sales.js (3540 lines) and several route files exceed 700 lines.
seed_data_creation: PROD Pharmacie Centrale test data left in place (not deletable while stock>0/sales linked): products 'TEST-REGRESSION Produit 789837' (stock 1, no price), 'TEST-REGRESSION Produit 789881' (stock 2, price 1500), 'TEST-REGRESSION Concurrence 1792789932' (stock 0); customers 'TEST-REGRESSION Client <suffix>' x2 (max_debt_limit 5000) each with a 3000 GNF debt; ~9 small cash sales (incl. one 0 GNF POS sale VNT-584505C3) and 2 returns. Main agent may want to clean these up / deactivate.
